segments.name: Primis Bank
segments.description: Provides commercial, commercial real estate, construction and consumer lending plus deposit services to businesses, non-profits, municipalities and individual consumers.
segments.evidence: Primis Bank. This segment specializes in providing financing services to businesses in various industries along with consumer and residential loans to individuals.

segments.name: Primis Mortgage
segments.description: Originates residential mortgages across the United States and sells them, earning mortgage banking income from that origination and sale activity.
segments.evidence: Primis Mortgage. This segment specializes in originating mortgages in a majority of the U.S.

revenueModel.text: Primis Bank earns interest income from loans it originates and from deposit-related services, while Primis Mortgage earns noninterest income from originating and selling mortgage loans.
revenueModel.evidence: The primary source of revenue for this segment is noninterest income generated from the origination and sale of mortgage loans, while the primary expense of the segment is personnel costs.

changes.text: The Company deconsolidated PFH, which owns the Panacea Financial brand, in 2025 after concluding it was no longer the primary beneficiary.
changes.evidence: As discussed in Note 1 – Organization and Significant Accounting Policies, the Company reassessed its relationship with PFH in 2025 and determined it remained a VIE but the Company no longer had a controlling financial interest, was not the primary beneficiary, and therefore de-consolidated PFH from the Company as of March 31, 2025.

changes.text: The Company sold most of its life premium finance loans in 2024 and stopped offering them in 2025.
changes.evidence: We sold a majority of these loans to EverBank, N.A. ("EverBank") in 2024 and no longer offer these loans as of January 31, 2025.
